summary:
Super Micro Computer 營收年增逾 93%，獲利表現大幅超越市場預期，展現強勁的 AI 伺服器市場需求。
• 營收達 111.2 億美元，年增率高達 93.16%。
• EPS 表現優異，超出市場預期幅度達 77.55%。
• 受惠於 AI 資料中心基礎設施的持續擴張與強勁訂單需求。
• 目前本益比僅 12.22 倍，顯示估值相對具吸引力。
ai_view:
觀點：本次財報釋出強勁訊號，顯示 AI 基礎設施需求仍處於高速成長期。儘管營收與獲利表現優異，但市場仍關注其毛利率結構與競爭格局。短期內強勁的獲利表現應能支撐股價動能，中長期則需密切追蹤其產品組合變化、供應鏈穩定性及大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）的資本支出預算調整。

需留意：伺服器硬體市場競爭加劇，可能壓縮毛利率空間。；供應鏈中關鍵零組件（如 GPU）的取得與成本波動風險。；市場對 AI 資本支出持續性的擔憂可能影響未來訂單能見度。

summary_en:
Super Micro Computer reported a 93% YoY revenue surge and significantly beat earnings estimates, reflecting robust demand for AI server infrastructure.
• Revenue reached $11.12 billion, representing a 93.16% year-over-year increase.
• EPS significantly outperformed expectations with a 77.55% surprise.
• Driven by sustained expansion in AI data center infrastructure and strong order backlogs.
• Trailing P/E ratio of 12.22 suggests an attractive valuation relative to growth.

ai_view_en:
View: The results signal robust, ongoing demand for AI infrastructure. While the earnings beat is impressive, investors remain focused on margin sustainability and competitive positioning. In the near term, the strong earnings should provide price support; for the mid-to-long term, monitor product mix shifts, supply chain stability, and capital expenditure adjustments by major Cloud Service Providers (CSPs).

Watch：Intensifying competition in the server hardware market may pressure gross margins.; Supply chain volatility regarding the availability and cost of critical components like GPUs.; Concerns over the sustainability of AI capital expenditures could impact future order visibility.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 達 1.70 美元，遠高於市場預期的 0.96 美元。
